title: alternanthera hirtula subvar. pallens
intro: Alternanthera hirtula subvar. pallens, commonly known as 'Golden Calalilly', is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaranthaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alternanthera hirtula subvar. pallens include wound healing, immune system support, and the management of certain infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
